The '''Thokosia system''' was located in the [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]], which connected it to the [[Shador system/Legends|Shador system]] as well as the [[Daalang system/Legends|Daalang system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Daalang sector/Legends|Daalang sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

At some point, the [[Governor/Legends|royal governor]] of the Thokosia [[Star system/Legends|system]] hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Uxbeg]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] a shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Spadda]] in the [[Aikhibba system/Legends|Aikhibba system]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> of the [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Before Uxbeg could pick the cargo up, however, it was intercepted by the smuggler's rival, [[Lo Khan]], who delivered it to<ref name="DES" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Aikhibba]] himself.<ref name="DES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thokosia system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published by [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DES" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square Q-13.<ref name="TEA" />
